workload.description: One environment variable declared in a schema file. Schema files hold ten variables each, so 640 variables is 64 files -- a large monorepo's worth of configuration. The ladder stops at 5,120 variables (512 files) because `discoverSchemaFiles` refuses more than 1,000 files as a sanity limit, which 10,240 variables would exceed.
